plainText:
Let's Memorize the Pokémon of the Unova Region~! (Korean:하나지방 포켓몬 외워보자~! Hanajibang Poketmon Oewoboja~!) is the second ending theme for the Korean dub of Pokémon the Series: Black & White. It debuted in BW024, replacing Walking Together Along a Road. It aired until BW058, when it was replaced by . It uses the same animation from the corresponding Japanese ending theme, Can You Name All the Pokémon? BW.

==Ending animation==
===Synopsis===
The entire ending sequence generally consists of acting as DJ, though just pointing about. The first variation takes place at night, while the second variation takes place during the day. Pokémon on a multi-platformed stage are unshadowed as their names are said. The scene eventually shifts to a bunch of lights, where other Pokémon appear as well. In the first variation, the scene goes back to the stage, while in the second variation, it goes to running on a disc, later with a sparkling electric trail behind it. Pikachu also says its name during specific episodes. After that, in both variations, Pikachu, , , and are then shown doing various things. Everything then goes back to the stage before everything shatters like glass, causing Meowth to enter a white ball of light in the background. The last set of Pokémon are then shown, ending with , who, much like Pikachu, occasionally says its name.
